## Management Benchmarks {#sec-assmt-bench}

Reference-point quantities are drawn from the ADMB benchmark products and summarized in
@tbl-reference_points.

For the terminal year, key benchmark relationships are:

- `Fend =` `r round(Fend, 4)`
- `Ftarg (reference F) =` `r round(Ftarg, 4)`
- `F/Ftarg =` `r round(F_Ftarg, 3)`
- `SBend =` `r format(round(SBend, 2), big.mark = ',')`
- `Bmsy proxy =` `r format(round(Bmsy, 2), big.mark = ',')`

These values are directly generated from the standardized report object and should be read in
conjunction with the source 2025 benchmark interpretations.
